runtimePreservation.notes: All 1512 resident/2290 wider native buildings and 1856 independent road records remain. Eight selected connected approaches retain their routes and exact per-lane joins; original road inputs, raw heightfield and native water remain unchanged. Two outside-ground probes remain within0.014m of raw sampled heights; only the declared approach cap changes rendered ground. Failure keeps original map content and no support/cap. Unload restores native ground bytes and releases every model/support geometry. No new engine or dependency changes were needed for this model.

limitations: Foundation elevations, structural sections and precise span/end allocation are approximate photo interpretations. A 4.37% longitudinal visualization grade follows the standard native bank endpoints; it is not an as-built surveyed road profile.
Nominal 92 m height has an unresolved datum; native terrain is coarse in the gorge. Native placement is not approved until current viewer renders are inspected.
Hidden structure, temporary signs/banners, vehicles, exact present traffic and trolley operation, adjoining retaining walls and utility lines crossing the gorge are excluded.
Physical laptop and phone/tablet timing measurements remain pending.

Bounded48×34.8m Arabkir approach retaining cut at sourceY100.3m; three original modeled support walls meet the sampled native ground at its exposed perimeter. Bridge and road centerlines remain exact; these walls are visualization support inferred from the standard terrain, not surveyed bridge members. Original DEM, water, paving and outside ground remain; unload restores native ground.
